subject.title: Testing guide + coverage matrix: exercise every connector lifecycle, with a two-tier CI gate before main

question: Should Crabbox operate a repository-funded authenticated provider lifecycle matrix, and if so which providers, credential boundary, spend ceiling, cancellation policy, and orphan-response owner are approved?
rationale: The remaining implementation would consume privileged credentials and funded cloud capacity, so safe defaults cannot be inferred solely from source code or the earlier secretless tiers.

options.title: Approve bounded hosted tier
options.body: Define an allowlisted provider subset, protected environment, monthly and per-run limits, cleanup guarantees, and an operational owner before implementing scheduled and manual runs.

options.title: Keep live runs operator-only
options.body: Document authenticated lifecycle commands and evidence expectations but leave execution outside repository GitHub Actions and required checks.

options.title: Close hosted-tier scope
options.body: Declare the two merged secretless tiers sufficient and track provider-specific lifecycle tests only when individual connectors change.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded hosted tier
recommendation.body: Define an allowlisted provider subset, protected environment, monthly and per-run limits, cleanup guarantees, and an operational owner before implementing scheduled and manual runs.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the accepted tier-one boundary and explicitly recorded the remaining hosted-live policy questions in the issue discussion.
